name: Pomerium-Route-Sync
description: Yasha template engine used to make refreshing Pomerium routes a breeze !

paths.name: PomeriumRouteSync templates folder
paths.description: Path to the Jinja2 template to use to render Pomerium routes. Please find the template here https://github.com/Lowess/docker-templates-unraid/blob/main/templates/pomerium/routes.yaml.j2

paths.name: Pomerium config
paths.description: Pomerium config.yaml file to store rendered routes in.

variables.name: Pomerium Domain
variables.description: Use the same domain as the one configured on your reverse proxy. If you use a DuckDNS wildcard domain, please put it here eg 'example.duckdns.org'

variables.name: Pomerium Authorized Emails
variables.description: A comma separated value (CSV) list of email adresses authorized to access Pomerium protected routes

variables.name: Pomerium Routes
variables.description: A comma separated value (CSV) list of routes. A route is expressed as {public HTTPS URL}=>{internal HTTP URL}, for example 'https://notes.acme.duckdns.org=>http://obsidian:3000'.

variables.name: Allow WebSockets
variables.description: Enable WebSocket upgrades on all generated routes. Required for applications such as LinuxServer Selkies desktops, including Obsidian.

variables.name: Preserve Host Header
variables.description: Pass the original public Host header to upstream applications on all generated routes.

variables.name: Pomerium Routes Authorized Domains
variables.description: A comma separated value (CSV) list of domains authorized to access Pomerium protected routes
